description: Block unsupported methods on the static website only
Block known repository and environment-file paths on the website
expression: http.host in {"mcshekinah.org" "www.mcshekinah.org"} and (lower(http.request.uri.path) in {"/.git" "/.env" "/supabase/.env"} or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.git/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.env.") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/supabase/.env."))
